title: Configuration update for the doubled machine
statement: For any states $s,s'$, valid input-head positions $ip,ip'$ on a fixed Boolean input $y$, natural number $v$, and integers $q,q'$, begin with a configuration in state $s'$, input-head position $ip'$, tape storing the binary expansion of $v$, and work-tape head at $q'$. Replacing its state by $s$, its input-head position by $ip$, and its work-tape head position by $q$ yields the configuration with those updated state and positions, the same tape, and empty output.
